derivations.quote: The exact multiplication by $M$ gives total error less than $M(3\delta+\eta)=\sqrt2\,M(3\ell+1)2^{-p}$

relations.predicate: has transforms laid out as in
relations.quote: The transforms are laid out as in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md).

Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time, truncated by $Q_p$ to $p$ bits of precision, which changes it by less than $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ (here $\eta$ is a truncation error bound, not the relative rank deficit of the recursive power saving page) without raising the norm.
The procedure keeps the retained order of [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md), passing the product to the opposite transform without reordering.

symbols.name: pointwise product
symbols.meaning: The pointwise product P(u,v)=uv/r of two arrays over the ring.
symbols.quote: Write $P(u,v)=uv/r$ for the pointwise product; here $P$ means this product, not the number of prefix values of the stream-operations page, the earlier tensor line of the subspace-labels page, or a subspace of $A$ as on the tensor-product page.

symbols.name: layout permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of records defined by the tape layout of the transforms.
symbols.quote: Perform both forward transforms and retain their common $LB$ order, with $L$ the layout permutation of records (here not the linear map of the contraction page, nor the total dimension loss of the subspace-labels page) and $B$ the bit-reversal order (here not the row length of the stream-operations page, the suffix digit count of the controlled-shifts page, or an orthogonal complement as on the subspace-labels and tensor-product pages).

symbols.name: bit-reversal order
symbols.meaning: The bit-reversal order applied along every axis.
symbols.quote: Perform both forward transforms and retain their common $LB$ order, with $L$ the layout permutation of records (here not the linear map of the contraction page, nor the total dimension loss of the subspace-labels page) and $B$ the bit-reversal order (here not the row length of the stream-operations page, the suffix digit count of the controlled-shifts page, or an orthogonal complement as on the subspace-labels and tensor-product pages).

symbols.name: truncation error bound
symbols.meaning: The bound sqrt2 times 2^{-p} on the change made by truncation to p fractional bits.
